newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 18.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:
* Seagram Co's Universal TV has signed an overall development and production deal with Miami-based pop impresario Emilio Estefan Jr.

* "Saturday Night Live" executive producer Lorne Michaels has entered into a partnership with General Electric's NBC Enterprises to create a new entity called SNL Studios, which will produce programming for all NBC dayparts.
* Barry Diller's HSN Inc finalized a deal to acquire 49.6 percent of Ticketmaster as the $215 million stock swap deal officially closed late Thursday.
* Katey Sagal, who played Peg Bundy in one of TV's longest-running sitcoms, "Married... With Children," has inked an exclusive two-year deal with CBS to develop a new series, sources said.
* Disney's "George of the Jungle" slammed into 2,391 theaters Wednesday night, grossing a stronger-than-expected $3.27 million to lead the daily box office.

* Morgan Creek Prods has expanded the duties of two new execs, as chairman and CEO James Robinson moves to revamp his Warner Bros.-based company in the wake of the departure of vice chairman and chief operating officer Gary Barber.
* Veteran producer David Picker has been named president of Hallmark Entertainment Prods Worldwide, in what sources see as a major expansion of the Hallmark brand into theatrical motion pictures.
